purpose: Custom application-security scanner (external Project #08 Web Security Scanner)
relationship: EXTERNAL PROJECT. This lab never modifies, copies or reimplements it. It is launched as a subprocess with its own interpreter and its HTML report is parsed.
interpreter_resolution: python on PATH as a last resort
severity_mapping: The scanner's own vocabulary (info, low, medium, high, critical) maps directly onto the lab's five levels.
parse_note: The scanner's HTML report is parsed rather than its console table, because the table is width-dependent and therefore not reliably machine-readable.

install.windows: Ensure the Project #08 directory and its virtual environment exist; set tools.custom-scanner.project_root in config/lab-config.json.
install.macos: As for Windows: point project_root at the scanner and create its virtual environment.
install.linux: As for Windows: point project_root at the scanner and create its virtual environment.
install.generic: This is an in-house component, not a third-party download. See docs/tool-guide.md.
